verdict.rationale: Vercel exposes a documented public OpenAPI spec (vercel-probe-3), an official CLI (vercel-probe-4, vercel-gh-2), and llms.txt/docs.md machine-readable docs (vercel-probe-1, vercel-probe-2), confirming a documented API surface AI-native users can drive programmatically. Additional docs describe AI-agent-oriented tool creation and agent deployment flows (vercel-docs-4, vercel-docs-10, vercel-docs-15). missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of API completeness and no explicit API versioning/rate-limit docs cited.
